system.description:
Replace «Anchor Howl» with this skill at CR11 or higher. You gain [Cancel: (STR Mod)]. This effect lasts until the end of the round.

(Hate Top): You recover [STR base] HP.

A special skill that raises the roar of the fabric and arouses the hostility of the enemy towards himself. The way you motivate yourself and keep an eye on your enemies will make them look like an insurmountable wall.
